description: Tax exemptions on gifts/prizes — must cite Income Tax Proclamation article numbers; no invention of rules
query: What income is exempt from tax in Ethiopia? I want to understand gifts, prizes and international income.
tool_payload:
[Source: income-tax-proclamation-979-2016 | Article 14 | Exempt income]
The following receipts are exempt from income tax: (a) income of foreign diplomatic missions and their employees; (b) amounts received as compensation for personal injury; (c) income of approved non-profit organizations from their approved activities.

[Source: income-tax-proclamation-979-2016 | Article 14 | Exempt income continued]
(d) amounts received as a gift from a spouse, a person related by blood or marriage to the second degree, if the recipient can establish the gift relationship to the satisfaction of the Authority.
expected_answer_forbidden_any: I cannot confirm the exact article
